info.title: lnkib Public API
info.description: REST API for lnkib (Link-in-Bio, bookings and Instagram comment/DM automation). Authenticate with an API key (`X-API-Key` header or `Authorization: Bearer`). Each endpoint lists the scope the key needs in `x-required-scopes`. Link-in-Bio and bookings work without an Instagram connection. AI-created bio pages are always private drafts; publishing needs the separate `bio:publish` scope. Rate limits: reads 60/min, writes 30/min (some endpoints lower).

post.summary: Create a Link-in-Bio page as a private draft
post.description: The page is ALWAYS created unpublished; the body has no publish flag. Publish it with `POST /bio/{bioId}/publish` (needs `bio:publish`). Links without an `id` get one assigned. Works without any Instagram connection.

put.summary: Update fields of a bio page
put.description: Only the fields you send change. The publish state and linked account never change here. Sending `links`, `socials`, `linkGroups` or `schedule` REPLACES the whole list; read the page first and send the complete list (use `POST /bio/{bioId}/links` to add one link).

post.summary: Add a manual (phone or walk-in) booking
post.description: Open days, hours, capacity and past dates are NOT enforced. No message is sent to the customer. Defaults to CONFIRMED. `startTime` is HH:mm (24h) and `bookingDate` is YYYY-MM-DD. `durationMinutes` (5-720) defaults to the page slot length. If `profileId` is omitted a hidden default booking page is used (created on first use). Works without a booking page or Instagram connection.
